newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed gets $450 mln Air Force deal.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed gets $450 mln Air Force deal.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Thursday it has received a $450 million contract from the Electronic Systems Center at Hanscom Air Force Base for reconnaissance systems.
The contract will enable the U.S. Air Force to procure a new line of reconnaissance and intelligence ground stations that use commercial information technology, Lockheed Martin said.
Lockheed Martin said the systems provide strategic and tactical commanders with battlefield, theater and strategic reconnaissance information.
Raytheon Co's E-Systems was named as the other contractor on the indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity contract, Lockheed Martin said.
Lockheed Martin's team in the contract includes Motorola Inc, Analytic Systems and Engineering Corp, Autometric and Arrowhead Space and Telecommunications, Lockheed Martin said.
